conditions.note: Delivered only while the car's gearbox is manual. TransmissionMode Sequential or H-pattern forces manual; Automatic never delivers; Follow game delivers only while the game's own transmission option is manual. A writer applying a Sequential profile sets TransmissionMode=Sequential.

Same gearbox rule. No gate held is neutral; reverse wins a shared gate; a gate outside the current car's gear ratios is ignored, never clamped. Only reverse and gear1-gear8 select a gear (neutral alone selects nothing), so a writer sets TransmissionMode=H-pattern only for an H-pattern profile with one of them bound, and writes no gate when two gates share one control.

artBindings: Preserved, never rewritten. An action the profile does not own keeps Art's own Settings.xml binding, unless that physical control (device instance, kind, index, overlapping hat sector) is one the profile maps: then Art's binding is not used (button channels stay neutral). Owned actions never use Art's binding.

qualification.writerScope: Schema 3, like schema 2, omits nothing: a writer may write every delivered action, within the transmission conditions. Written is not qualified; runtimeShown, fixtureOnly and notQualified keep that distinction.
notQualified: physical wheel, pedal and keyboard driving through the ordinary session (needs an attended owner run)

qualification.artOnlyActions: Repair puncture, quick restart and look left, right and forward have no shared action. They use Art's own Settings.xml bindings on the shared copy (artBindings rules); no writer sets them.
